title: Debugger stalls/crashes when selecting remote nodes in the editor with "GameView" feature disabled
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in: v4.8.dev.custom_build [5ec712e22], v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (5ec712e22) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 04 Mar 2026 18:25:08 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 143.98 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.46 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Updated my build of 4.8 earlier to use some of the newer features, was testing some of my game then this issue came up...

As far as i can tell it seems to happen when selecting anything, just crashes the application. _however_ it's fine if i expand/collapse the node, instead of directly selecting it. Seems inconsistent in my testing but it has existed since at least 4.8dev7

In my experience the game either entirely stalls and doesn't update at all, or crashes entirely.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d607961e-4b69-420a-9512-ecc59e0b2b0d

example with the application becoming unresponsive:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ef937a14-8222-4fe1-b2c3-f17c9b13b655

### Steps to reproduce

- run application
- make sure the "game view" editor feature is disabled (this seems important?)
- open remote scene tree
- select a Node/Node3D/Node2D/Control node in the remote scene tree
